name: application-container-box
description: Next.js + MongoDB app with a build-once, promote-everywhere CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions.
highlights: Multi-stage Docker build, non-root, about 75 MB
Immutable sha-<commit> tags, promoted to production without a rebuild
Health probes, Prometheus metrics, structured JSON logs

name: mywebapp-k8s-helm
description: GitOps Kubernetes platform on k3d, reconciled by Flux.
highlights: Gateway API ingress with cert-manager TLS
Sealed Secrets, HPA and VPA, Mongo on a StatefulSet
Prometheus, Grafana, Loki and Alloy observability
